decisions.story_title: Iran-linked Handala Hack deploys HEAVYGRAM backdoor using Telegram as C2
decisions.reason: Group-IB research links Handala Hack (Void Manticore/MOIS) to HEAVYGRAM Python backdoor. Uses Telegram bots for C2, steals credentials, records audio, captures screenshots. Also uses CRUDEEXCLUDE to disable Defender. Targeted social engineering campaign via Telegram/WhatsApp/Instagram.
